brain.commentary: The regime is risk_on, but conviction and composite scores are only modest, advisory risk is elevated, and the apparent long signals are not sufficiently broad or strong to justify an aggressive overlay. BTC is the most credible signal but still low-alpha. ETH and SOL carry higher beta/volatility, while LTC is effectively non-constructive. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile because their zero volatility, expected shortfall, liquidity, and institutional fields indicate missing or unreliable risk data; their nominal long signals should be heavily discounted.
